positions.name: ValidReproductionConstraints
positions.frame: what does a valid reproduction of a production failure pattern require?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around a single test case's purpose: src-1 identifies the production failure pattern being reproduced (a ## heading with no id field), and src-2 prescribes the non-negotiable behavioral constraints that validate the fix (must not crash, must produce a valid slug). The shared authority-ranking stance and competence value span both — the speaker diagnoses the defect and commands the remedy. A conviction gradient runs through the set: src-1 is a settled claim about what the test does, while src-2 is a decision-level operational rule — but this tension is the frame itself, the question of what a reproduction must hold and must deliver.
